This transformation does not change the sum of the roots of the polynomial. The reason is that shifting a polynomial function horizontally (left or right) by adding or subtracting a constant from its argument does not alter the sum of its roots.

Here, \( a = 1 \) and \( b = -49 \), so the sum of the roots of \( f(x) \) is:

\[ -\frac{-49}{1} = 49. \]

\[ 49. \]
